about.en: Miu (MIU) is a cat-themed community memecoin on the Sui network, launched in December 2024, whose project also offers staking, token-creation and token-locking tools. It is the Sui coin type 0x32a976482bf4154961bf20bfa3567a80122fdf8e8f8b28d752b609d8640f7846::miu::MIU; it is unrelated to other tokens using the MIU ticker on Base and Solana.
